name: Steve
description: ALL RAINBOW! The Maker is a pulsing star (pulsar) with spinning rainbow beams. Bad guys are poofy round creatures with giant googly eyes and goofy smiles. Rainbow glowing bullets. Deep space background.

name: Caleb
description: Bad guys are huge! Shoot one and it splits into 2 medium ones. Shoot those and they split into 2 tiny ones. Tiny ones finally die — but they're fast!

name: Eloise
description: Monsters are now COMPLETELY ABSURD: 2-4 bloodshot googly eyes each drifting independently, 3-5 flailing wiggly arms with grabby claws, forked tongue, drool, uneven fangs, and a random accessory — top hat, party hat, spinning antenna star, or devil horns!

name: Cyrus
description: LAVA at the bottom of the arena! Glowing orange-red with bubbles and heat haze. Touch it and you die instantly — no second chances!

name: Liam
description: Monsters are SLOW and OOZY! They creep along leaving glowing goo puddles everywhere they go. The goo shimmers and fades — but there's a lot of it!

name: Ben
description: A disco ball hangs from the ceiling! Every 15 seconds: DISCO INFERNO — monsters stop chasing and shimmy in place, rainbow spotlights sweep the arena, and DISCO INFERNO flashes in giant rainbow letters.

name: Nathan
description: Rocks appear in the arena! Climb on one and monsters can't touch you — but they'll chomp through it! Each rock survives 4 bites before crumbling. Cracks show how much is left.
